question: Does embodiment or disembodiment make a difference for one non-different from Śiva?
premises: The liberated person has rejected identification with all universal forms.
Embodiment and disembodiment are presented as alternatives.
inference: For one non-different from Śiva, there is no essential difference between having a body and not having one.
plain_english: Therefore, for one who is non-different from Śiva and has set aside all universal forms, there is no real difference whether he is in a body or not.
